text:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer™ | Sounds of the Galactic League
A Star Wars™ racing adventure demands a soundtrack that fires up the emotions and gets pilots motivated to win at all costs. In this video, we go behind the scenes during the recording of the game’s soundtrack at the Vienna Synchron Stage, where multi-award winning composer Gordy Haab and Fuse Games' Music & Narrative Director Nathaniel Daw discuss their process when creating the soundtrack for Star Wars: Galactic Racer.

The original soundtrack arrives October 6 and is available now for pre-save and pre-add on Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music. The single “The Soul of Racing (Main Theme)” is out now.
 
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/38NOnClJATSTssK1XcWHxi
Apple Music - https://music.apple.com/us/album/the-soul-of-racing-main-theme/6812461037?i=6812461038
Amazon Music - http://music.amazon.com/albums/B0HJY91JQK?trackAsin=B0HJXPY67N
 
Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches worldwide on October 6th. Pre-order today for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
